title: Graph-of-Skills: Dependency-Aware Structural Retrieval for Massive Agent Skills
reason: Builds an executable dependency graph and retrieves context-budgeted, dependency-complete skill bundles with large token savings, but does not certify task-local effect equivalence to the complete skill artifact or retained-atom necessity.

title: SkillRAE: Agent Skill-Based Context Compilation for Retrieval-Augmented Execution
reason: Compiles task-specific compact, grounded, immediately usable contexts with rescue-aware evidence recovery, but reports downstream benchmark gains rather than a per-task equivalence certificate against the complete artifact.

title: ClawTrace: Cost-Aware Tracing for LLM Agent Skill Distillation
reason: Uses cost-attributed traces to compile preserve, prune, and repair skill patches and shows rule-type quality regressions, but does not construct a source-anchored slice whose net effect is statistically equivalent to the complete skill.

title: SkillFlow: Scalable and Efficient Agent Skill Retrieval System
reason: Selects relevant skills under context constraints and shows that use does not always imply gain; it does not reduce one skill artifact while preserving its paired task-local effect.

title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
reason: Provides the whole-skill versus no-skill marginal utility reference that EffectSlice would reuse, but does not search for or certify an effect-equivalent source-grounded procedural subset.

title: Anything2Skill: Compiling External Knowledge into Reusable Skills for Agents
reason: Compiles evidence-linked procedural contracts but does not behaviorally minimize a compiled skill against its complete-artifact task effect.

title: SkillFoundry: Automated Mining and Validation of Agent Skills for Scientific Tasks
reason: Mines, repairs, and validates scientific skills with downstream evaluation, but does not emit a simultaneous equivalence and retained-deletion certificate relative to the full artifact.
